instruction.vi: Chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói 1–2 phút; ghi âm và tự nghe lại.

questions.prompt_en: Describe a job you would like to try for one day. You should say: what the job is; where you would do it; what you would need to do; why you want to try it.
questions.prompt_vi: Part 2: chuẩn bị 60 giây, nói tối đa 2 phút.

answer.model_en: I would like to try working as a radio presenter for one day. I have always been curious about what happens behind the scenes of a live programme, especially how presenters keep a conversation interesting while following a strict schedule. If I had this opportunity, I would prefer to work at a local station that broadcasts news and interviews. I imagine my first task would be preparing questions and checking information about the guests. During the programme, I would need to listen carefully, introduce each topic clearly and respond when someone gave an unexpected answer. That sounds challenging because there would be very little time to stop and think. I would probably feel nervous before speaking into the microphone, but I think that would also make the experience exciting. One reason I want to try this job is that it combines communication with preparation. A good presenter needs to sound natural, yet the programme cannot simply be improvised from beginning to end. I would also like to learn how producers and technicians work together in the studio. Even if I discovered that the job was too stressful for me, one day in that environment would help me understand the skills behind programmes I normally listen to without much thought.

questions.explanation_vi: Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc. Đối chiếu bốn tiêu chí nói.

phases.utterance_vi: Bạn sẽ có một phút chuẩn bị và tối đa hai phút nói. Hãy ghi từ khóa thay vì viết cả câu.
Ghi một ý cho từng gạch đầu dòng, sau đó nghĩ thêm một chi tiết hoặc ví dụ.
Nói tự nhiên; nếu bí ý, dùng một câu chuyển ý rồi nói tiếp.
Kiểm tra đã nói đủ ý, có ví dụ cụ thể và dùng thì phù hợp chưa. Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc.
